title: Stage 1: traces
summary: The bookshop's lookup endpoint with the SDK, the ASP.NET Core instrumentation and a span of your own.

steps.title: The bookshop
body: A small bookshop API is going to production. Over three stages you give it the telemetry the on-call team will rely on. Stage 1:
traces. The service has one endpoint, `GET /books/{id:int}`, backed by an in-memory catalogue (ids 1 to 3). Unknown ids answer `404`.
Keep the code you pass: the next stage opens with it.

steps.prompt: A 404 for an unknown book id: what status should the server span get?
options: Unset: a 4xx is the caller's problem; record what happened as an attribute instead
steps.explain: Server spans only mark 5xx as Error. The useful signal is an attribute (`app.book.found = false`) you can count and filter.

steps.title: Trace the lookups
prompt: - the SDK with service name **`bookshop`** and the ASP.NET Core instrumentation;
- an `ActivitySource` **`Bookshop`** (registered) and, in the handler, a span **`load book`** with `app.book.id` (int) and
solution: var found = books.TryGetValue(id, out var title);
return found ? Results.Ok(new { id, title }) : Results.NotFound();
public static readonly ActivitySource Source = new("Bookshop");
hints: The tracing setup from module 3, with `AddService("bookshop")` and `AddSource("Bookshop")`.
template: public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
var ok = await DojoOtel.Span(a => a.DisplayName == "load book" && Equals(a.GetTagItem("app.book.id"), 1));
var miss = await DojoOtel.Span(a => a.DisplayName == "load book" && Equals(a.GetTagItem("app.book.id"), 99));
Dojo.Check("load book spans with app.book.id as an int", ok is not null && miss is not null, "Spans: " + string.Join(", ", DojoOtel.Spans.Select(a => a.DisplayName)));
Dojo.Check("app.book.found is a bool", ok?.GetTagItem("app.book.found") is true && miss?.GetTagItem("app.book.found") is false, "");
var server = await DojoOtel.Span(a => a.Kind == ActivityKind.Server && miss != null && a.TraceId == miss.TraceId);
Dojo.Eq("the 404's server span stays Unset", "Unset", server?.Status.ToString());
